cover: A Core Web Vitals check for one important page

slides.title: Run it through PageSpeed Insights
slides.body: It shows real-visitor scores if you have enough traffic, plus a lab test. The real-visitor scores are what Google uses.

slides.title: Compare with the targets
slides.body: LCP 2.5 seconds or less. INP 200 milliseconds or less. CLS 0.1 or less. Three in four visits need to meet each one.

slides.title: Find failing pages in Search Console
slides.body: The Core Web Vitals report groups your pages by status and shows which measurement each one fails.

slides.title: Match the failure to the usual cause
slides.body: Slow LCP: oversized images. Poor INP: too much JavaScript from widgets and tags. High CLS: images and banners with no space set aside.

slides.title: Do the task on a real phone
slides.body: Book or check out the way a visitor would, on a mid-range phone on mobile data, and compare it with the reports.

slides.title: Record the scores before each change
slides.body: Note them before adding another widget or tracking tag, so you can see whether that change made things worse.
